notes.title: Fear Odyssey 1.2
notes.content:
Update 1.2 now available!


 Some grammatical errors have been corrected
 Sounds added in various interactions
 Improved performance in some phases
 Improvements to quality of life features


To contact us, send an email to: natantorresdev@gmail.com

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Graphics improvement.
 Some enemies have become more difficult.
 Some bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Fear Odyssey Demo Update 2.0
notes.content:
In this update:


 Death animation
 New dialogues
 Menu improvements
 Improvement in collisions
 Improved enemy mechanics
 Adjusted sound volume


Several bugs were fixed (Thank you SPCine team for the QA work)

The final version with full content will be available soon, with a total of 8 levels, improvements to the demo levels, and 20 achievements!
